parameters.glove: uncased: every token is lower case, so the toy lower-cases what is typed

vocabularyRule.order: GloVe's file order, its training vocabulary by descending count
vocabularyRule.keep: tokens matching ^[a-z]+$ that are not on the stop list; nothing dropped or moved by hand

projection.method: t-SNE (scikit-learn TSNE), fitted once on all 50,000 position words in the full 300 dimensions
projection.scaling: centred, then divided by the largest absolute coordinate, one scale for both axes
projection.caveat: t-SNE keeps local neighbourhoods and discards global distances; positions are a picture of the space, not the space
